purpose: Market-based whitespace decision support; not a financial site-selection decision
population_source: WorldPop Global2 R2025A v1; UAE constrained population count; 2025; approximately 100m; people per pixel
competitor_scope: Observed Google Places competitors from the defined adaptive search; not an exhaustive UAE business census
catchment_scope: Modelled 10-minute destination drive-time catchments using OpenRouteService and OpenStreetMap roads; not live traffic or observed customer origins
